{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills create an attackable {c_important}Shade Totem{/c} for {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds. Any damage it takes is replicated onto surrounding enemies at {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]%{/c} effectiveness. 

This effect is treated as a {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill. You may only have {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} |4{c_important}Shade Totem{/c}:{c_important}Shade Totems{/c}; active at a time.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
